official: 港区ひとり親家庭等の医療費の助成に関する条例及び港区子ども医療費助成条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 議案一覧

name: 医療費助成に個人番号カードを使えるように
summary: 現在は医療証を提示して医療費の助成を受ける仕組みです。この議案により、受給資格を確認できる個人番号カードを提示しても助成を受けられるようになります。カードで確認できるのは、対応している医療機関等です。
changes: 医療証に加え、受給資格を確認できる個人番号カードの提示でも医療費助成を受けられるようにする
who: ひとり親家庭等の医療費助成を受ける人
子ども医療費助成を受ける人
why: ＰＭＨを活用し、個人番号カードで医療費助成の受給資格を確認できるようにするためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Allow Individual Number Cards to be used for medical expense assistance
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Minato City Ordinance on Assistance with Medical Expenses for Single-Parent Families, etc., and the Minato City Child Medical Expense Assistance Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, people receive medical expense assistance by presenting a medical assistance certificate. Under this bill, they will also be able to receive assistance by presenting an Individual Number Card that can verify their eligibility. Card-based verification is available at medical institutions and other providers that support it.
changes: Allow people to receive medical expense assistance by presenting an Individual Number Card that verifies eligibility, in addition to a medical assistance certificate
who: People receiving medical expense assistance for single-parent families, etc.
People receiving child medical expense assistance
en.why: The ward says this is to use PMH and make it possible to verify eligibility for medical expense assistance with an Individual Number Card.
